items.name: Marble
items.headline: Marble with movement, depth, and lot-specific character.
items.summary: Marble is commonly selected for vanity tops, furniture, hospitality interiors, and feature surfaces where natural veining is part of the design intent.
items.imageAlt: Carrara quarry region visited by WHITEROCK for marble block sourcing
items.hardness: Typically Mohs 3–4; confirm the selected stone and finish.
items.absorption: Varies by quarry and lot; confirm the current test report and sealing plan.
items.maintenance: Use pH-neutral care products and review sealing frequency for the intended exposure.
items.caveat: Natural veining, tone, fissures, and mineral movement vary by block and slab. Approve the physical sample and lot range before production.

items.name: Granite
items.headline: Granite for durable work surfaces and project applications.
items.summary: Granite is commonly reviewed for kitchens, commercial counters, furniture, and selected exterior-adjacent uses where project conditions are confirmed in advance.
items.imageCaption: Illustrative material reference · confirm by sample
items.hardness: Typically Mohs 6–7; confirm the exact mineral composition and finish.
items.absorption: Varies by source and lot; use the current product test report for specification.
items.maintenance: Use stone-safe cleaners and confirm whether sealing is required for the selected granite and exposure.
items.caveat: Performance and appearance vary by geological source. Final suitability follows the approved sample, test documents, drawing, and written quotation.

items.name: Quartz
items.headline: Quartz for repeatable color programs and interior surfaces.
items.summary: Engineered quartz is commonly specified for interior countertops and vanity programs where repeatability, available slab format, and documented product performance are important.
items.imageCaption: Illustrative material reference · confirm exact product
items.hardness: Product-specific engineered surface; use the approved technical sheet rather than a single Mohs claim.
items.absorption: Product-specific declared value; request the current test report for the exact product.
items.maintenance: Routine pH-neutral cleaning; heat, UV, chemical, and exterior limitations must follow the exact product documentation.
items.caveat: Digital colors are planning references. Confirm exact brand formulation, slab size, batch range, technical data, and physical sample before approval.

items.name: Quartzite
items.headline: Quartzite for expressive natural surfaces with project-specific review.
items.summary: True quartzite is commonly considered for premium counters and feature surfaces. Geological identification, absorption, finish, and fabrication behavior must be confirmed for the selected lot.
items.imageAlt: Illustrative stone surface reference pending approved quartzite photography
items.imageCaption: Illustrative surface reference · quartzite photography pending
items.hardness: Typically around Mohs 7 when identified as true quartzite; verify the selected material.
items.absorption: Varies by quarry and lot; confirm identification and current test results.
items.maintenance: Use stone-safe care products and establish sealing and stain-control requirements from the approved material test.
items.caveat: No named WHITEROCK quartzite swatches are currently published. Material options and supporting documents require owner approval before listing.

items.name: Travertine
items.headline: Travertine with linear movement and tactile architectural character.
items.summary: Travertine is commonly considered for furniture, interior architectural elements, and selected wall or hospitality applications where fill, finish, edge detail, and exposure are agreed.
items.hardness: Typically Mohs 3–4; filled and unfilled surfaces require separate review.
items.absorption: Naturally porous and lot-specific; confirm fill system, test report, and sealing plan.
items.maintenance: Use pH-neutral care products and maintain the approved sealer and fill system for the intended use.
items.caveat: Open pores, fill, color movement, and edge behavior vary. Wet-area or exterior use must be reviewed against the exact product and project conditions.

items.name: Engineered Marble
items.headline: Engineered marble for repeat interior vanity programs.
items.summary: Engineered marble is commonly reviewed for repeat bathroom and hospitality programs where color direction, molded or cut components, and order-specific documentation are confirmed.
items.imageCaption: Illustrative material reference · confirm exact product
items.hardness: Product-specific; the mineral and resin formulation plus current test report govern.
items.absorption: Product-specific declared value; request the current technical sheet and test report.
items.maintenance: Use non-abrasive pH-neutral care products and follow the exact product guidance for heat, chemicals, and stain removal.
items.caveat: Confirm formulation, color range, dimensions, test documentation, and physical sample for the exact product before production.
